method: Same-JVM baseline vs optimized; warmup 1000 commands, seven timed rounds, median. Warm rounds: 4000 commands / 16000 probes. Cold rounds: eight fresh networks, 40 commands / 160 probes each.
eligibility: LU system with at least 128 states, at least 256 changed physical-RHS probe validations on the same matrix, at most eight referenced gauge variables, conservative finite-solve bound.
limitations: Targeted probe microbenchmark only; not whole-server TPS/FPS or chunk-reload timing. 80-node and cold cases leave sparse validation inactive; their timing differences reflect JVM/scheduling noise.
